normative_rule_catalog.statement: Validation reports must be built only from captured executions or truthful pending/blocked records.
normative_rule_catalog.title: Validation integrity

normative_rule_catalog.statement: FCR-01 through FCR-10 and every authority mechanism lack authority to waive non-falsification, external-law limits, durable authority records, exact release scope, truthful validation, overclaim prohibitions, historical preservation, revocation/supersession traceability, material-defect disclosure, machine-readable FCR records, pilot privacy minima, security/privacy baselines where applicable, or high-consequence independent-review requirements.
normative_rule_catalog.title: Non-waivable governance core

normative_rule_catalog.statement: Artifact lifecycle, authority-event status, certification status, evidence status, and readiness status are orthogonal dimensions and must not substitute for one another.
normative_rule_catalog.title: Dimensional separation

normative_rule_catalog.statement: Production authorization requires exact release identity and may be no-exception or with-express-exceptions; a clean production authorization must not require an artificial exception record.
normative_rule_catalog.title: Production authorization

normative_rule_catalog.statement: FCR-09, FCR-10, critical-control waivers, material privacy/safeguarding/security exceptions, pilot evidence substitution, critical finding closure, and production authorization with exceptions require independent second review; absent that reviewer, issuance and closure are blocked.
normative_rule_catalog.title: Second review

normative_rule_catalog.statement: Exact source bytes, SHA-256, byte length, source status, and limitations must be recorded; unavailable evidence must not be marked resolved.
normative_rule_catalog.title: Source traceability

normative_rule_catalog.statement: No file may claim approval, adoption, activation, implementation verification, production authorization, Founder-review readiness, or independent validation unless exact evidence and authority are present.
normative_rule_catalog.title: Unsupported overclaim prohibition

normative_rule_catalog.statement: Credible challenges require acknowledgement, triage, investigation, escalation, written disposition, and reopening effect deadlines.
normative_rule_catalog.title: Challenge timing

normative_rule_catalog.statement: The package must identify a separate Governance Maintenance Standard predecessor or state that no separate predecessor was issued.
normative_rule_catalog.title: Maintenance supersession truth

round_2_source_limitation: Resolved for Cursor, Claude, and Perplexity Round 2 reports by authenticated repository-native source copies. Remaining external limitations concern independent Round 3 re-review, human/legal/privacy/regulatory review, and repository enforcement.
truth_principle: FOUNDER AUTHORITY MAY CHANGE THE REQUIRED INTERNAL GATE OR EVIDENCE SUFFICIENCY DETERMINATION, BUT IT MAY NOT CHANGE HISTORICAL FACT.
